scenarios.name: blocked_without_confirmation
scenarios.description: The irreversible Confirm step must refuse to run unauthorised. The default is refusal: an irreversible action should need someone to say yes.

scenarios.name: opens_when_authorised
scenarios.description: The same flow with explicit confirmation.

scenarios.name: over_approval_limit
scenarios.description: The bank declining a deposit above the operator's limit. A real answer, not a crash — and the natural escalation trigger.

scenarios.name: member_not_found
scenarios.description: Nothing to open a sub-account against.

scenarios.name: permission_denied
scenarios.description: The operating account may not view this member.

scenarios.name: unparseable_deposit
scenarios.description: The app rejects the deposit. Our type step sent something wrong, so this is our bug and not the bank's answer.

scenarios.name: session_expired_mid_flow
scenarios.description: The app signs us out mid-flow. Named in known_outcomes, so it is detected in milliseconds rather than by waiting out the checkpoint timeout — and classified hard_failure because re-authenticating needs credentials the automation must never handle.
